articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.snippet: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
articles.snippet: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

articles.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
articles.snippet: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
articles.snippet: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
articles.snippet: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.
